# Hockey Computindo

> Premium and free themes for Astro, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Blazor, Docusaurus, Starlight, Hugo, Jekyll, and Eleventy. 90+ Lighthouse, SEO-ready, full source code, one-time purchase.

Hockey Computindo is a theme shop and web architecture studio. We sell curated, hand-built static site themes that you own 100%. No subscriptions. We also build custom web systems (headless commerce, booking, SSG, AI automation) via Fiverr escrow.

## Themes

- [All Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/): Browse the full catalog of free and premium themes.
- [Premium Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/premium/): Premium themes with lifetime ownership, full source code.
- [Free Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/free/): Free themes to download and try.

## Theme Stacks

- [Astro Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/astro/): Astro and Starlight themes for docs, SaaS, blogs.
- [Next.js Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/next/): Next.js themes and starters.
- [Nuxt Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/nuxt/): Nuxt 4 themes for SaaS and startups.
- [Svelte Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/svelte/): SvelteKit themes for content and SaaS.
- [Blazor Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/blazor/): Blazor WebAssembly themes for .NET developers.
- [Docusaurus Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/docusaurus/): Docusaurus documentation themes.
- [Hugo Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/hugo/): Hugo themes and templates.
- [Jekyll Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/jekyll/): Jekyll blog and portfolio themes.
- [Eleventy Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/eleventy/): Eleventy (11ty) JAMstack themes.
- [Bludit Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/bludit/): Bludit flat-file CMS themes.

## About

- [Axcora Framework](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/others/axcora-framework/): All-in-one SSG and CSS framework built in C.
- [CAX SSG](https://cax.axcora.com): The C static site generator that powers this site.
